description: Search MFM public companies, pages and published datasets by keyword, company name or ticker. An empty result means no MFM record matched those words: say that MFM does not publish it under those words and never attribute figures from other sources to MFM. Results contain document identifiers and public URLs; private portfolios and accounts are excluded. SELECTION BY PARAMETERS (for clients that only expose search and fetch): start the query with "screen:" followed by conditions separated by spaces, e.g. "screen: buffett_roe_gross>0.15 buffett_roic_tangible>=12% debt_to_equity<0.8 country=US,DE level=1,2 sort=buffett_roic_tangible order=desc limit=10". Ratios are fractions (0.15 = 15%; "15%" is accepted); options: country=, sector=, industry=, level=1,2,3, developed=true, name=, sort=metric, order=asc|desc, limit=1-25 (default 25), columns=a,b. Each result is one company with the requested metrics in the title and text and the fetch id of its complete page. The order is the one chosen by the user: a data selection, never a recommendation. Quota per MFM account: at most 100 different companies shown per calendar month (UTC), shared with the website; re-running a filter or showing a company already shown this month costs nothing. PORTFOLIO CALCULATOR (same clients): start the query with "portfolio:" followed by settings and lines separated by ";", e.g. "portfolio: residence=IT; currency=EUR; tax=26%; S&P 500 30000/25000; Apple 5000/1000; US:MSFT 4000/3500 USD; MSCI World 20000/18000 hedged" (each line: security current_value/book_cost in the reference currency; company id, COUNTRY:TICKER, ISIN, company name, or the index an equity ETF tracks). One result with the whole calculator summary in its text, the same as the portfolio_calculator tool; nothing is stored. BOND CALCULATOR: search "bond: etf=TLT" or "bond: settlement=2026-11-04; currency=EUR; price=100; 2027-11-04=105". No quota consumed. Metrics: years_in_profit_5: Profitable years in the last 5; years_owner_earnings_to_debt: Years of owner earnings to repay debt; years_owner_earnings_to_debt_with_commitments: Years of owner earnings to repay debt + commitments; years_earnings_to_debt: Years of earnings to repay debt; years_earnings_to_debt_with_commitments: Years of earnings to repay debt + commitments; shares_change_3y: Change in shares outstanding, 3 years [fraction]; cash_conversion: Cash conversion; interest_coverage: Interest coverage ratio; croe_gross: CROE [fraction]; croe_tangible: Tangible CROE [fraction]; croic_gross: CROIC, gross (adjusted FCF) [fraction]; croic_gross_with_commitments: CROIC, gross (adjusted FCF) + commitments [fraction]; croic_gross_avg_5y: CROIC gross, 5-year average [fraction]; croic_tangible: CROIC, tangible (adjusted FCF) [fraction]; croic_tangible_with_commitments: CROIC, tangible (adjusted FCF) + commitments [fraction]; debt_to_equity: Debt-to-equity ratio, equity excluding OCI; debt_to_equity_with_commitments: Debt-to-equity ratio, equity excluding OCI + commitments; capital_intensity: Capital intensity [fraction]; fcf_margin: Free cash flow margin, MFM adjusted [fraction]; net_margin: Net profit margin, MFM adjusted [fraction]; owner_earnings_to_assets: Owner earnings to total assets [fraction]: Card owner earnings (metrics.owner_earnings) / closing total assets for the same fiscal year (values.total assets), in the same currency and unit. Only with immaterial non-controlling interests: their equity absent with evidence, zero with evidence, or in absolute value below 5% of positive total equity; their income, when available, in absolute value below 5% of net income for the same year (zero net income allowed only with zero minority income). Otherwise null with a reason. Unchanged numerator, including negatives; consolidated owner earnings are not reconstructed. MFM proxy: all capex treated as maintenance, additional working capital not deducted; neither a guaranteed lower bound nor distributable cash.; owner_earnings_to_assets_avg_5y: Owner earnings to total assets, 5-year average [fraction]: Arithmetic mean of the five annual owner_earnings_to_assets ratios for consecutive distinct fiscal years, all available; otherwise null with a reason. Each ratio requires the same currency and unit for numerator and assets within its year; different currencies across years do not prevent averaging. It is not a ratio of cumulative amounts.; owner_earnings_cagr_3y: Owner earnings CAGR, 3 years [fraction]; revenue_cagr_3y: Revenue CAGR, 3 years [fraction]; revenue_cagr_5y: Revenue CAGR, 5 years [fraction]; buffett_roe_gross: Buffett ROE, gross (income / adjusted capital) [fraction]; buffett_roe_gross_with_commitments: Buffett ROE, gross (income / adjusted capital) + commitments [fraction]; buffett_roe_tangible: Buffett ROE, tangible (income / adjusted capital) [fraction]; buffett_roe_tangible_with_commitments: Buffett ROE, tangible (income / adjusted capital) + commitments [fraction]; roe_gross: Return on equity (ROE) [fraction]; roe_tangible: Return on equity (ROE), MFM tangible [fraction]; roi: ROI [fraction]; buffett_roic_gross: Return on invested capital (ROIC), MFM gross [fraction]; buffett_roic_gross_with_commitments: Return on invested capital (ROIC), MFM gross + commitments [fraction]; buffett_roic_gross_avg_5y: Buffett ROIC gross, 5-year average [fraction]; gross_roic_minus_buffett_wacc: Gross ROIC − Buffett WACC [fraction]; gross_roic_minus_buffett_wacc_with_commitments: Gross ROIC − Buffett WACC + commitments [fraction]; buffett_roic_gross_min_5y: Buffett ROIC gross, 5-year minimum [fraction]; textbook_roic: Return on invested capital (ROIC), textbook [fraction]; textbook_roic_minus_wacc: Textbook ROIC − WACC [fraction]; buffett_roic_tangible: Return on invested capital (ROIC), MFM tangible [fraction]; buffett_roic_tangible_with_commitments: Return on invested capital (ROIC), MFM tangible + commitments [fraction]; buffett_roic_tangible_with_commitments_avg_5y: Buffett ROIC tangible + commitments, 5-year average [fraction]; tangible_roic_minus_buffett_wacc: Tangible ROIC − Buffett WACC [fraction]; tangible_roic_minus_buffett_wacc_with_commitments: Tangible ROIC − Buffett WACC + commitments [fraction]; tangible_roic_minus_buffett_wacc_adjusted: Tangible ROIC + commitments − adjusted WACC [fraction]; tangible_roic_minus_wacc_no_premium: Tangible ROIC − WACC, no premium [fraction]; tangible_roic_minus_wacc_no_premium_with_commitments: Tangible ROIC − WACC, no premium + commitments [fraction]; operating_income_cagr_3y: Operating income CAGR, 3 years [fraction]; operating_income_cagr_5y: Operating income CAGR, 5 years [fraction]; owner_earnings_over_assets: Owner earnings / total assets [fraction]; derivatives_change_3y: 3-year derivatives change [fraction]; buffett_wacc: Weighted average cost of capital (WACC), MFM Buffett method [fraction]; buffett_wacc_with_commitments: Weighted average cost of capital (WACC), MFM Buffett method + commitments [fraction]; buffett_wacc_adjusted: Buffett WACC adjusted (derivatives 3y, MFM heuristic scenario) [fraction]; buffett_wacc_no_premium: Buffett WACC, no premium [fraction]; buffett_wacc_no_premium_with_commitments: Buffett WACC, no premium + commitments [fraction]; textbook_wacc: Weighted average cost of capital (WACC), textbook [fraction]

query.description: Short keywords, a company name or a ticker (e.g. "Apple" or "US:MSFT"). Clients that only expose search and fetch can start the query with "screen:" (selection by parameters) or "portfolio:" (portfolio calculator), with the syntax in the tool description; "quota" returns the remaining account allowances.
